name: Barbell Clean and Press
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, bend your hips and knees with a flat back, and grip the bar just outside your shins.
Drive through your feet, accelerate the bar explosively at your thighs, and rotate your elbows under to catch it across your front shoulders.
Stand fully tall, squeeze your glutes, and brace your core tightly with legs still.
Press the bar strictly overhead until your arms lock straight with your biceps beside your ears.
Lower the bar smoothly back to your front shoulders and then down to the floor under control.
tips: Keep the bar traveling close to your shins and torso during the clean.
Avoid dipping your knees or leaning backward during the strict overhead press.
